archimate:CourseOfAction.name: 8. Transforming our finance systems​
archimate:CourseOfAction.documentation:
Moving people from legacy finance systems and onto streamlined modern tools to save time on frustrating workarounds.​
Priority for pre-Christmas design work, given the importance of a new Finance solution. Potential to include consideration for Commercial requirements. ​
Level 2 capabilities are: Financial operations ​ Financial reporting ​ Human Resources​ Commercial ​ Strategic finance​ Operations oversight​ Risk management ​
